name: pagida
description: Pagida: explainable, local-first phishing detection for web pages and webmail. Checks every page and email you open and tells you in one sentence why.
author: Aryan Dhingra

scripts.zip: node scripts/build.mjs && cd dist && zip -qr ../pagida-v$npm_package_version.zip . && cd .. && echo "packaged pagida-v$npm_package_version.zip"
scripts.zip:firefox: TARGET=firefox node scripts/build.mjs && cd dist-firefox && zip -qr ../pagida-v$npm_package_version-firefox.zip . && cd .. && echo "packaged pagida-v$npm_package_version-firefox.zip"
